question: Did the snowfall on Saturday 21 Dec 2024 reduce NYC yellow taxi trips compared with the other Saturdays in December 2024, and why?

calls.content:
{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips,
       w.snow_mm,
       h.holiday_name,
       d.d_day_name
 FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
 JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date
 LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date
 JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
 WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
   AND d_dow = 7
 ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "whybot.nyc_weather_daily", "whybot.us_holidays", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],
  "note": "All Saturdays in December 2024 (d_dow=7). Snowfall and holiday flags included for analysis."
}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, w.snow_mm, d.d_day_name FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 7 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","whybot.nyc_weather_daily","TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],"note":"Snowfall on Saturdays in December 2024; compare 2024-12-21 against other Saturdays."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips,
       CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.trips END AS target_trips,
       CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-12-28' THEN y.trips END AS post_christmas_trips,
       w.snow_mm AS snow_mm_21_dec
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date
WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-12-21', DATE '2024-12-28')
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "whybot.nyc_weather_daily"],
  "note": "Uses conditional aggregation pattern to avoid self-joins on the same view; compares target date 2024-12-21 against post-Christmas baseline 2024-12-28."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_dist,
       y.avg_total_amount AS avg_amount,
       w.prcp_mm,
       w.snow_mm,
       h.holiday_name,
       d.d_day_name
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date
LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  AND d_dow = 7
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": [
    "whybot.yellow_daily",
    "whybot.nyc_weather_daily",
    "whybot.us_holidays",
    "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"
  ],
  "note": "Filters to Saturdays (d_dow=7) in Dec 2024; LEFT JOIN on holidays ensures one row per date even if no holiday match."
}
